SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, April 21, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 21, 2021 via Zoom.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, George Borst and new
  member Jenny Jolly.
  Members Absent: Lorraine Missick
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Service Manager, Amanda Triay,
  Community Service Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, February 19,
  2020 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: Curbside only since March 2020. 119 meals served per
  week, it will continue until County approves congregate meals. Average 130 meals.
  Participants are required to sign up for curbside meals.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: Zoom Bingo on May 3rd some people attended, next Zoom Bingo will
  be on Monday, June 7th. About $2,700.00 in the account. Bingo will begin on May
  3rd and will continue every 1st and 3rd Monday each month.

5. Meals on Wheels: No report.

6. Account Balance: $3,800.00

7. Senior Program Fees: No classes. AARP had the Tax Program outside.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: All on-line. The number of attendees will be reduced when
  reopen. Virtual classes will continue through the summer.

9. Aging Next: No report.
   New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Wednesday, May 26th – Celebrate Older American’s month, Recognition of
  Volunteers, 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM. Drive-thru in the parking lot of the Community
  Center.

11. Facilities Report: Renovated Veterans Hall Women’s restroom, starting on the Men’s
  restroom. Leak in slab, Eagle Scouts Project installing benches and additional roses
  are being planted by the Eagle Scouts. Public Works fixed the walkways around the
  building. Community Center had a break-in, broken windows having to be repaired.
  Nothing was taken. Replace roof tiles in the Community Center. New refrigerator
  and freezer (commercial size) for the kitchen. Installed camera on back end of
  building and windows have been replaced.

12. Public Comments: George announced County is opening protocol at Marshall
  Canyon scheduling tee times for La Verne. People are able to share carts now.
  Masks in Club House. Driving range is open.

  Scott announced Hillcrest is opening for residents only, starting May 3rd group
  activities.

  Yvonne talked about the re-organization of the Community Center. Chad Peterson
  is the Community Services Supervisor and Amanda Triay, Community Services
  Specialist. Yvonne is the Community Services Manager. She also mentioned the
  City is planning something for the 4th of July but it hasn’t been finalized yet.

13. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  The meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. Next meeting will be held Wednesday,
  May 19, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
